findings.played: attack the player with ST01-004 Guntank[1] (HP2/3)
findings.better: attack the rested GD05-058 Shiden Custom (Ryusei-Go)[76] (+Mikazuki, AP6, HP1/4, Blocker) with Guntank[1]
findings.reason: Guntank[1] (2 AP) kills the 1-HP Shiden and dies to its 6 AP: a 2-cost unit for a 3-cost Blocker plus its pilot, removing P1's only unit and future blocker. P0 already led 6 shields + base vs 3, so the extra shield was worth less. Racing is defensible, so arguable.

findings.played: end_main after deploying Gundam (MA Form); neither Guntank attacked and Intercept Orders stayed in hand
findings.better: attack the rested GD05-060 Flauros+Akihiro (AP6, HP1/4) with Guntank[13] (if the HP1 Shiden blocks, Shiden dies instead) and attack with Guntank[1]; or play Intercept Orders first to rest Shiden (HP1 <= 3) and trade both Guntanks into P1's two HP1 units
findings.reason: Both P1 units had 1 HP, so any attack kills its target: a 2-cost Guntank for the 4-cost Flauros (or the 3-cost Shiden if it blocks) plus its pilot. P1 had 0 open resources, so there was no risk from tricks. Units without Blocker give no defence by staying active. Instead both 6-AP units survived and hit P0 again on turn 11.

findings.played: attack the player with GD05-058 Shiden Custom (Ryusei-Go) [Blocker], which only destroyed P0's EX Base
findings.better: keep Shiden active as a Blocker and attack only with Flauros (and Barbatos)
findings.reason: P1 had 2 shields, no base and no other Blocker in hand, and P0 had three active units able to attack next turn (Gundam MA Form, Guntank+Sayla, Guntank). Resting the only Blocker handed P0 exact lethal on board, which P0 took on turn 12. With the Blocker home, P0 needs a 4th attack or removal. Breaking the EX Base did not change the race (P0 still had 6 shields).

findings.played: end_main with 1 open resource and ST05-003 CGS Mobile Worker (Lv1 C1) in hand
findings.better: deploy CGS Mobile Worker
findings.reason: Free body with an activated ability for next turn and no downside (hand not near the limit, deployed active so it can't be attacked). Low impact.

items.notes: #46-#47: P0's Intercept Orders says 'choose 1 to 2' but only one target (Barbatos 1st[57]) was picked, and the transcript shows no second selection prompt (game c5456 shows one with a 'done' option). I could not tell whether a second target (Flauros, HP1) was offered, so this is not reported. #57: Unforeseen Incident on a non-Blocker Barbatos during P0's lethal swing did nothing, but the game was won anyway (not reported). #26/#28: attacking face before deploying the second Guntank is fine.

findings.played: play ST04-013 Hawk of Endymion to return the 1-cost unpaired GD01-035 Zaku II to hand
findings.better: pass and keep Hawk for a more valuable target (a paired or linked unit, or an attacker during an action step)
findings.reason: It costs a card to set P0 back 1 resource of tempo, and P0 simply replayed the Zaku II on turn 5. Low-value use of a removal-like command.

findings.played: GD01-115 Zeon Remnant Forces dealing 1 damage to Guncannon+Sleggar (HP2/4 -> 1/4, has Repair)
findings.better: pass in the action step and keep the 1-damage Action command for a unit it can finish
findings.reason: No target could be destroyed (Gundam[53] was already dying in battle, Gundam[64] was at 5/5). The damage on a Repair unit had no lasting effect.

findings.played: end_main without attacking with ST01-001 Gundam+Amuro (AP7, HP5/5) while P0 had no units
findings.better: attack the player for a shield (P0 at 5)
findings.reason: P0's board was empty. The only risk was a newly deployed linked unit attacking the rested 5-HP Gundam, which would have been an even trade at worst.

findings.played: end_main with no attacks and no Jaburo activation (three ready units vs P0's single Zee Zulu+Full Frontal)
findings.better: activate GD04-122 Jaburo (rest Guntank) to rest Zee Zulu (Lv2), then attack it with Gundam+Amuro (AP6 vs HP4) to destroy Zee Zulu and Full Frontal, then attack the player with Guncannon
findings.reason: This removes P0's only unit and two cards at no material cost: Gundam survives at 1 HP and has Repair 2. Even plain attacks would have taken shields from P0 (5 shields, no base). Instead Zee Zulu survived, and on turn 15 P0 destroyed Jaburo and a shield.

findings.played: GD01-115 Zeon Remnant Forces dealing 1 damage to ST01-001 Gundam+Amuro (HP4/5, Repair 2)
findings.better: end_main and keep the Main/Action command
findings.reason: No P1 unit could be destroyed and every one had Repair, so the damage was healed at the end of P1's turn. Kept as an Action command, it could finish a unit damaged later.

findings.played: ST08-015 Davao activation (2 resources, recover 2 HP) on GD04-008 Gundam at full HP 4/4
findings.better: target ST01-001 Gundam+Amuro[64] at HP1/5
findings.reason: Healing an undamaged unit has no effect. The only damaged unit was the HP1 Gundam, so 2 resources were spent for nothing.

items.notes: #23-#29 (P1 turn 8), killing three units for one GM, was well played. #49: Gelgoog trading into Gundam+Amuro was reasonable. #79-#86: P1 had no lethal on turn 18 (P0 had 4 shields and P1 had 4 attackers).

findings.played: end_main with 2 open resources
findings.better: deploy ST05-004 Graze Custom (Lv2 C1, 2/2)
findings.reason: An affordable unit with no drawback and nothing else to spend the resources on; P0 floated its whole turn.

findings.played: activate ST05-003 CGS Mobile Worker (HP1/2) whose only legal 'your Unit' target was itself, destroying it
findings.better: don't activate; deploy Graze Custom (and keep Mobile Worker)
findings.reason: AP+1 on a unit that has just rested is useless, and the 1 damage destroyed P0's only unit for no gain.

findings.played: end_main with 3/3 resources, an empty board and Graze Custom in hand
findings.better: deploy Graze Custom
findings.reason: Second turn in a row of floating every resource while holding an affordable unit with no drawback.

findings.played: end_main without attacking
findings.better: attack the player with ST01-004 Guntank (2 AP) and GD01-008 Guntank (1 AP), destroying P0's 3-HP EX Base
findings.reason: P0 had no units at all, so there was nothing to punish the rested Guntanks and nothing that could block. It was free damage that strips the base.

findings.played: end_main with 4/4 resources and no action at all
findings.better: pair ST01-010 Amuro Ray with ST01-004 Guntank (Amuro rests Barbatos Adapt, HP4 <= 5), attack the rested Adapt with Guntank+Amuro (4 AP vs 4 HP), deploy ST01-005 GM and attack the player with GD01-008
findings.reason: P0 had 0 open resources, so no responses were possible. Doing nothing wasted the whole turn and left Barbatos Adapt alive.

findings.played: play the second ST05-004 Graze Custom
findings.better: play GD05-117 Become a Shield (same cost) on own Barbatos 2nd Form and P1's GD01-008 Guntank (HP1/2)
findings.reason: This destroys an enemy unit, and the damaged Barbatos 2nd gets AP+2, instead of adding a vanilla 2/2 (which Intercept Orders rested and a Guntank then killed).

findings.played: ST01-012 Thoroughly Damaged on Graze Custom[15] (2/2 -> 1/2)
findings.better: target Gundam Barbatos 2nd Form (HP2/4, 4 AP while damaged), or cast both Thoroughly Damaged on it instead of the second GM to destroy it
findings.reason: Barbatos 2nd was P0's strongest attacker and was in range of the two 1-damage commands. The ping on Graze killed nothing.

findings.played: attack the player with ST01-005 GM (removing the EX Base), then the second GM attacked the player too
findings.better: trade a GM (3 AP this turn) into the rested Graze Custom[2] to cut P0's attackers
findings.reason: P1 was at 1 shield plus Davao against P0's 6 shields plus base and could not win a race. Reducing P0's attackers mattered more, and the rested GMs were then picked off.

findings.played: attack the player with GD01-001 Gundam, then use Hawk of Endymion to bounce Barbatos 5th Form
findings.better: attack the rested Barbatos 5th Form (HP3/5) with GD01-001 Gundam (3 AP) to destroy it, and keep Hawk for P0's next attacker
findings.reason: At 1 shield against 4 shields, P1 had to defend. The bounce only delayed a unit that P0 (10 resources next turn) could redeploy at once, and it did, linked, for lethal.

items.notes: #29-#30 confirm that 'choose 1 to 2' prompts offer a second selection with 'done'. #32-#39 (P1 turn 10: Amuro rests a unit, Unforeseen Incident saves the Gundam in battle) was well played. #97-#103: P0's lethal was executed correctly.

findings.played: Mikazuki Augus' When Paired self-damage on GD05-060 Gundam Flauros+Akihiro (HP2/4 -> 1/4)
findings.better: deal the self-damage to ST05-002 Barbatos 2nd Form[12] (the unit just paired, HP5/5)
findings.reason: Barbatos 2nd gets AP+2 while damaged and had full HP, so the damage was free value there. Instead it put P0's best unit on 1 HP.

findings.played: play GD02-058 Ryusei-Go (Graze Custom II) with the last 2 resources
findings.better: deploy ST05-015 Isaribi (C1)
findings.reason: P0 was at 3 shields with no base and no Blocker. P1 had three units untapping, 6 resources next turn and a Sinanju revealed into hand by Char's Zaku II, so one linked deploy meant exact lethal. With Isaribi, P0 would have 2 shields plus a 5-HP base (two hits to clear), so P1 needs 5 attacks instead of 4. Ryusei-Go adds no defence and its Deploy even damaged Barbatos[12]. P1 won next turn with exactly 4 attacks (Gelgoog, Sinanju+Full Frontal, Gelgoog, Schuzrum-Galluss).

items.notes: Turn 11 as a whole (#48 deploying Barbatos 2nd instead of McGillis' Schwalbe Graze [Blocker] while at 3 shields and no base) belongs to the same defensive failure as #60; it is reported once. #33-#40: holding the linked Flauros back (it would trade with Schuzrum-Galluss if rested) is defensible. #29: Rick Dom trading into Barbatos 1st with Breach killing Isaribi was good. #65-#74: P1's lethal was executed correctly.
